categoryDescriptions.LOGIN_ACCESS: Sign-in, password, single sign-on (SSO), two-factor, role and permission problems.
categoryDescriptions.BILLING: Invoices, charges, plan changes and refunds.
categoryDescriptions.BUG: A feature that does not work as expected or shows an error.
categoryDescriptions.PERFORMANCE: The product or its API is slow, timing out or down.
categoryDescriptions.INTEGRATION: Problems with webhooks, API keys or a connected app set up by the customer.
categoryDescriptions.DATA_REQUEST: Requests to export, delete or correct account data.
categoryDescriptions.GENERAL: Questions, feedback and anything that fits no other category.

policies.guidance: Confirm the requester is a workspace admin, read the SAML or OIDC error, and offer a temporary bypass while the identity provider settings are fixed.
Verify identity out of band, through another workspace admin or the billing contact, before removing two-factor authentication.
Check the payment processor for two captures on the same invoice; refund the duplicate and send a receipt.
Check the status page and link the ticket to the open incident.
Ask for the endpoint response code and recent delivery IDs; never ask for secrets or API keys.
Confirm the requester owns the account, deliver any requested export first, check for active subscriptions or legal holds, then schedule deletion for the requested date.

LOGIN_ACCESS: Check the identity provider and the user's role
BILLING: Compare the invoices and the payment record
BUG: Reproduce the problem with the steps given
Collect the browser and the time of the error
PERFORMANCE: Check the status page and open incidents
Collect the affected page or endpoint and the time
INTEGRATION: Read the delivery log for the endpoint
Ask for response codes, never for secrets
DATA_REQUEST: Log the request with its date
Confirm the requester owns the account
GENERAL: Respond with the next supported step

SERVICE_BLOCKED.explanation: Users cannot sign in or their work is blocked

BROAD_IMPACT.explanation: Many users or a whole workspace are affected
